status: materialized before generation; X0008 binds the hash of this file
question: How far can we keep halving teacher search (4k -> 2k -> 1k -> 512) before the quality penalty accelerates enough that the compute savings stop being worth it?
context: S7-S showed breadth beats depth; S8 removed the student-compute confound; S9-S11 located a small per-halving tax (8k->4k ~+0.0005, ->2k ~+0.001). S12 extends the curve downward where the tax is expected to accelerate past the margin.

scale.name: 2x
scale.note: one teacher budget; each arm spends it all, buying more rows as labels get cheaper

nesting: 4k subset 2k subset 1k subset 512 (closest-prefix at each depth along ONE frozen order)

population.base: the S7-S universe (79,483 records, order sha256:bbdb9a3b...) is EXTENDED, not replaced
population.extension: append-only: new EPD-start games are normalized, leakage-joined against the full 575-record N0010 source, and the new clean records are hashed (seed 20260920) and APPENDED after the old order
population.why_append: the old order's prefixes are preserved exactly, so the already-purchased 4k and 2k observations along it remain valid; the order is frozen and hash-recorded either way
population.adequacy: extend until >= 1.15 x the calibration-predicted 512 prefix; stop rather than truncate

labels.reuse: 4k and 2k streams are carried into the new normalization by record identity (EPD ids survive); re-verify coverage over their prefixes
labels.buy: 1k and 512 streams along the extended order until the 2x crossing resolves

training.regime: fixed updates: MAX_UPDATES 760, BATCH 256 = 194,560 sample presentations for every arm (equal student compute, the S8 control)

analysis.primary: d = test_loss(512) - test_loss(4k), paired by seed, per width; positive = 512 worse
analysis.bounds: separate one-sided 95% lower and upper bounds (exact Student-t per df)
analysis.acceleration: does the per-halving tax grow (2k-4k vs 1k-2k vs 512-1k)? that bend is where savings stop paying
analysis.economics: realized node totals and rows per arm, reported separately from quality

firewall.no_outcome_inspection: the complete lattice and its X#### must be frozen before any outcome is inspected
firewall.no_target_values: prefix membership is decided by realized node counts only

stop_conditions: the old order's prefix does not reproduce
the carried labels do not cover their prefixes
the universe cannot reach 1.15x the 512 prefix
X#### cannot truthfully seal the design
